name: Tonia Reyes Uranga
office: Water Replenishment District of Southern California, Member, Board of Directors, Division 3

items.text: Tonia Reyes Uranga is a former Long Beach city councilmember. In her campaign for the Water Replenishment District, she supports affordable water access for all, self-sustaining water policy, and environmental justice. Her campaign cites her experience with water quality, groundwater management, and stormwater contamination.
